derived_from: human-adopted C+ quality workflow plus repeated human preference for the T1-Codex final English over the comparable T1-OMP final English
change_summary: Select current Codex as the production English owner while retaining locked Flash/high source analysis, high-risk bridge generation, fresh Pro/max Chinese challenge, two bilingual reviews, title and concision gates, post-concision semantic regression, and target-specific human approval.

selection_evidence.prior_model_only_result: A frozen same-source diagnostic comparison preferred T1-OMP by a small margin; it explicitly was not named human adjudication.
selection_evidence.new_human_result: The user reported on 2026-08-28 that the 2026-08-27 human reviews consistently found T1-Codex slightly better than T1-OMP.
selection_evidence.decision_rule: Direct whole-draft human English judgment outranks model aggregate scores, finding counts, backtranslation, length, and mechanical QA when both candidates have passed blocking semantic and structural gates.
selection_evidence.scope: workflow selection only; it does not approve any future translation or waive document-specific human review

source_authority.conflict_resolution: source.dj wins; unresolved core ambiguity requires a named human decision or blocks drafting

default_routing.scope: MPI Chinese-to-English Buddhist books, articles, and documents

t1_codex_quality.english_owner: current Codex task configured as GPT-5.6-Sol/high
t1_codex_quality.source_and_review_runtime: locked OMP for Flash/high and fresh Pro/max roles

t1_omp_rollback.activation: explicit user request, Codex-role unavailability, production-gate failure, or bounded blinded comparison

full_pretranslation_experiments.activation: explicit user selection plus isolated evidence

source_analysis.reads: frozen Chinese source-side inputs only; no English

post_concision_semantic_regression.checks: both Chinese-to-English coverage and English-to-Chinese support for every high-risk constraint

adopted: high-risk-only Chinese semantic clarification and English structure planning
not_default: quality claims based on rewrite count, shorter output, or aggregate model score

release_validation.comparison: same frozen source, terminology, review gates, and anonymous human adjudication against T1-OMP rollback
release_validation.pass_rule: T1-Codex wins or ties in all genres, has no new unresolved critical or major defect, and shows no recurring Chinese-understanding failure
